title: Mount Abe school district welcomes new staff for 2026
text:
Mount Abe school district welcomes new staff for 2026
BRISTOL — The Mount Abraham Unified School District announced that it has hired 30 new employees for the 2026-2027 school year. Classes in the Bristol-area schools began on Wednesday, Aug. 26.
The news teachers and staff are:
Mount Abraham Union Middle and High School
Gabe Billings, Athletics and Activities Director; Lilith Blackwell, Literacy Interventionist; Edward Bolin, Custodian 2nd shift; Will Chaney, Social Studies; Frank McGowan, Behavior Assistant; and Nicole Schlenter, School Nutrition Assistant Manager.
Monkton Central School
and Margaret Phelan, Educational Assistant
Beeman Elementary School in New Haven
Portia Senning, Literacy Interventionist; and Caitlynn Duval, Custodian
Robinson Elementary School in Starksboro
and Michelle Bennett, Educational Assistant for SPED
Bristol Elementary School
and Bethany Orvis, Educational Assistant
Districtwide
and Hannah Sheehy, SLP to Eval Team
